behavior.off: Search and display results in the user's selected language, with access to the Arabic original when available.
behavior.on: Show the verified Arabic original together with an available verified meaning translation in the selected/search language.

languageRouting.sourceLanguage: Arabic when the canonical source is Arabic
languageRouting.supportedPairs: Arabic plus any supported interface/search language

display.verification: source and provenance available on demand

persistence: store preference per user/browser settings without changing the canonical source record
